about: SessionTimeout — warn before a session ends for inactivity, and let them stay without losing anything. Any activity restarts the clock. `warnBefore` seconds before the end, a dialog says when they wil

timeout.about: Seconds without activity before the session ends. Default 900 (15 minutes).

warnBefore.about: Seconds before the end to warn. Default 120 (2 minutes); never under 20.

onExtend.about: Keep the session alive on the server, without reloading the page.

onTimeout.about: The session has ended: go to the page that says so.

enabled.about: Off while there is no session (signed out).

announceEvery.about: Seconds between spoken updates while warning. Default 15.

announceFinal.about: Speak every second in the last this-many seconds. Default 20.

syncTabs.about: Keep tabs of the same service in step (activity and staying in one count in all).

message.about: In place of the variant's sentence; gets the time left in words.

answers.about: What happens to what they entered: "We will save your answers."
